title: Miten and kuinka: answering about manner
focus: Miten asks how something happens. Miten sinä puhut? — Puhun hitaasti.
targetSkills: Miten and kuinka: answering about manner

exercises.prompt: Choose the question meaning “How do you speak?”  Address one person (sinä).
exercises.explanation: Singular refers to one person or one thing in these patterns. Miten asks how something happens. Kuinka can ask about manner too in these examples, although the two words are not interchangeable in every Finnish expression. The complete question means “How do you speak”.
requiredSkills: Miten and kuinka: answering about manner

optionFeedback.Miten sinä puhut?: Singular refers to one person or one thing in these patterns. Miten asks how something happens. Kuinka can ask about manner too in these examples, although the two words are not interchangeable in every Finnish expression. The complete question means “How do you speak”.
optionFeedback.Miksi sinä puhut?: Miksi asks for a reason: why. The requested question is “Miten sinä puhut?”
optionFeedback.Milloin sinä puhut?: Milloin asks for a time: when. The requested question is “Miten sinä puhut?”

exercises.prompt: Answer “Miten te puhutte?”: choose “We speak clearly.”
exercises.explanation: Answer with a manner word, often an adverb, which tells how an action happens: hyvin (“well”), hitaasti (“slowly”), nopeasti (“quickly”) or selvästi (“clearly”). The adjective describing a person and the adverb describing an action are different: hidas (“slow”) becomes hitaasti (“slowly”), with the weak d changing to t in this stem. The complete reply means “We speak clearly”.
